先猜一猜，再动手: Make a prediction, then try it
画面与真实世界: The illustration and the real world
画面暂时无法显示，仍可操作控件阅读讲解。: The scene is unavailable. Controls and explanations remain available.
科学互动演示，讲解与操作在画面旁边: Interactive science illustration with explanations and controls alongside
从不同高度的风开始，观察雷暴中的旋转怎样发展。漏斗云和触地的旋转气流，是不是同一: Start with winds at different heights and explore rotation in a thunderstorm. Is a visible funnel cloud the same as a ground-reaching vortex?
关闭凝结云的显示：旋转的空气就不存在了吗？: Hide the condensation cloud. Has the rotating air disappeared?
典型超级单体的一种教学路径；轨迹代表空气，不是每场雷暴都会出现龙卷风。: One illustrative supercell pathway; traces represent air. Most thunderstorms do not produce tornadoes.
不同高度的风，方向和速度可能不同。这种差别能给空气带来旋转。: Winds at different heights can differ in speed and direction. This can give air a rotating motion.
强上升气流能把一部分旋转抬起来、倾斜，让雷暴内部开始有竖直的旋转。: A strong updraft can lift and tilt some of that rotation, helping vertical rotation develop within a thunderstorm.
雷暴里的旋转还不是龙卷风。只有少数风暴会继续在地面附近发展出强旋转。: Rotation inside a storm is not yet a tornado. Only some storms go on to develop intense rotation near the ground.
与雷暴相连的强旋转气柱延伸到地面时，才称为龙卷风。看得见的漏斗由小水滴组成，不一: A tornado is an intensely rotating column connected to a thunderstorm and reaching the ground. Its visible condensation funnel need not extend all the way down.
环境风切变可提供水平涡度。本页展示超级单体相关的一种概念路径，不涵盖陆龙卷、水龙: Environmental shear can supply horizontal vorticity. This illustrates one supercell-related pathway, not every mechanism such as landspouts or waterspouts.
上升气流的倾斜与拉伸能增强竖直涡度；近地面涡度来源、下沉气流及其与上升气流的相互: Tilting and stretching by updrafts can enhance vertical vorticity. Near-surface vorticity, downdrafts and interactions with updrafts also matter.
中气旋并不保证产生龙卷风。这里的两项控制只是示意性条件，并非龙卷生成判据或概率模: A mesocyclone does not guarantee a tornado. The two controls represent illustrative conditions, not a tornadogenesis criterion or probability model.
凝结漏斗与动力学涡旋并不重合。可见漏斗未接地时，触地的涡旋仍可能存在；尘土也可能: The condensation funnel and dynamical vortex are not identical. A vortex can reach the ground before its visible funnel does; dust may reveal its near-surface portion.
台风是海洋上尺度很大的热带气旋；龙卷风是雷暴中的局部强涡旋。台风的外围雷雨带有时: A typhoon is a large oceanic tropical cyclone; a tornado is a localized intense vortex in a thunderstorm. Typhoon rainbands can sometimes produce tornadoes, but they remain distinct phenomena.
气流轨迹、云形与进度均为概念示意，没有求解三维大气动力学。调高参数只是在本例中选: Air paths, cloud shape and progress are conceptual, not a three-dimensional atmospheric simulation. Higher settings select more favorable conditions in this example, not a guarantee of tornado formation.
这里的上升或旋转条件较弱，演示停留在雷暴气流，没有画出触地龙卷。即使条件看起来很: The updraft or rotation is too weak in this example, so it shows storm airflow without a ground-reaching tornado. Even apparently favorable real storms may not produce one.
当前概念模型不显示近地面强涡旋；真实龙卷生成还取决于更多未建模的热力与动力过程。: The concept model does not show an intense near-ground vortex under these settings. Real tornadogenesis depends on additional thermodynamic and dynamical processes.
漏斗云不一定延伸到地面: The visible funnel need not reach the ground
容易混淆的地方: A distinction to keep in mind
不同高度的风速或风向变化可以提供水平涡度。涡度描述气流局部的旋转倾向，并不要求空: Changes in wind speed or direction with height can provide horizontal vorticity. Vorticity describes local rotational tendency without requiring a visible funnel. This illustration starts with environmental shear and follows one supercell-related pathway.
u、v 是水平风分量，z 为高度；右式忽略垂直速度的水平梯度，只用来说明垂直风切: u and v are horizontal wind components and z is height. The right-hand approximation neglects horizontal gradients of vertical velocity and only illustrates how vertical shear supplies horizontal vorticity.
比较高处和近地箭头；把风差调小，看看旋转示意是否减弱。: Compare winds aloft and near the ground. Reduce the wind difference and watch the rotation weaken.
画出的螺旋线是气流示意，不是空气中真的存在一根管子。: The helix is a flow illustration, not a physical tube in the air.
空间分布不均匀的上升气流能把部分水平涡度倾斜到竖直方向。已有竖直旋转在气柱被拉伸: A spatially varying updraft can tilt horizontal vorticity into the vertical. Stretching an already rotating column can amplify its vertical rotation and help sustain a rotating updraft. These explain part of mesocyclone development, not all of tornadogenesis.
ζ 为竖直涡度、w 为上升速度；前两项示意倾斜，后一项示意拉伸。“⊃”表示只列出: ζ is vertical vorticity and w vertical velocity. The first two selected terms describe tilting and the last stretching. “⊃” indicates an incomplete set: compressibility, baroclinic, frictional and other contributions are omitted.
点上升气流阶段，观察旋转轴改变方向；再降低上升气流强弱做对比。: Select the updraft stage and watch the rotation axis tilt; reduce updraft strength for comparison.
这些线只说明倾斜与拉伸的概念，不是实际空气微团的计算轨迹。: These lines illustrate tilting and stretching, not calculated trajectories of real air parcels.
中气旋不等于龙卷风: A mesocyclone is not a tornado
超级单体中的中气旋是较大范围的旋转上升气流，许多中气旋并不产生龙卷风。近地面涡度: A mesocyclone is a broader rotating updraft in a supercell, and many never produce tornadoes. Near-ground vorticity sources, convergence and stretching, downdrafts and cold-pool thermodynamics affect whether intense low-level rotation develops.
不能把“水平旋转竖起来”当作完整因果链。页面两项参数只控制本例强弱；现实没有对应: Turning horizontal spin upright is not the entire causal chain. The two controls set this illustration’s strength; no corresponding simple product threshold guarantees a real tornado.
在雷暴旋转阶段观察：云中已有旋转，但地面尚未出现本例的强涡旋标记。: At the storm-rotation stage, notice rotation aloft before the strong near-ground vortex marker appears.
近地旋转与云底可见漏斗的演变不必同步，不能只看云是否“伸下来”。: Near-ground rotation and a visible cloud-base funnel need not evolve together; a funnel extending downward is not the sole indicator.
龙卷风是与对流云相联系并接触地面的旋转气柱。可见漏斗由凝结水滴组成，可能没有延伸: A tornado is a rotating column of air connected to a convective cloud and in contact with the ground. Its visible condensation funnel may stop above the surface; dust and debris can reveal rotation below. The switch hides condensation only, leaving the illustrated dynamical state unchanged.
可见范围取决于湿度、温度和凝结条件，旋转气柱的范围则是动力学问题。图中尘土帮助标: Visibility depends on humidity, temperature and condensation, while the vortex extent is dynamical. Dust marks the near-ground part here but does not provide a wind-speed estimate.
关闭凝结漏斗云：仍能看到旋转气流和地面尘土，说明空气没有随着云一起消失。: Hide the condensation funnel: airflow and ground-level dust remain, showing that the air did not disappear with the cloud.
本页没有模拟所有龙卷类型；非超级单体龙卷可以有不同的形成过程。: Not all tornado types are modeled; nonsupercell tornadoes can follow different pathways.
